# endpointcentral_custom_group_membership (Resource)

Adds one computer (or user) to a static or static unique custom group.

This resource is **non-authoritative**: it manages only its own member, so several configurations, or members added in the console, can share a group. To own a group's complete member list instead, use `endpointcentral_custom_group_memberships_exclusive`; do not use both for the same group.

The API can only replace a group's whole member list, so each change reads the list, edits it and writes it back. Changes within one `tofu apply` are serialized; two applies running at the same time can overwrite each other's changes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "endpointcentral_custom_group" "engineering" {
  name = "engineering-macs"
}

data "endpointcentral_computer" "studio" {
  name = "mac-001"
}

# One member per resource; other members of the group are left alone.
resource "endpointcentral_custom_group_membership" "studio" {
  group_id    = endpointcentral_custom_group.engineering.id
  resource_id = data.endpointcentral_computer.studio.id
}

# Many members from a list of computer names.
variable "dev_macs" {
  type    = set(string)
  default = ["mac-vm-01", "mac-vm-02"]
}

data "endpointcentral_computer" "dev" {
  for_each = var.dev_macs
  name     = each.value
}

resource "endpointcentral_custom_group_membership" "dev" {
  for_each    = data.endpointcentral_computer.dev
  group_id    = endpointcentral_custom_group.engineering.id
  resource_id = each.value.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) ID of a static or static unique custom group.
- `resource_id` (String) Resource ID of the computer (or, for a user group, the user) to add.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<group_id>/<resource_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <group_id>/<resource_id>
tofu import endpointcentral_custom_group_membership.studio 301/2001
```
